steps.label: 2301-own-set-shared-hml-tab
command: (() => {if(location.pathname!=='/item/all/modify.donga'||new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089242')throw Error('Own edit required');const tab=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]')].find(e=>e.getAttribute('href')==='#tabHml');if(!tab)throw Error('Known HML tab required');tab.click();const owner=document.querySelector('[data-editor-url]');if(owner.dataset.itemDetailId!=='2088906'||[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-webhwp-result]')].some(e=>e.value))throw Error('Own latest clean edit required');return {editorUrl:owner.dataset.editorUrl,itemId:owner.dataset.itemId,itemDetailId:owner.dataset.itemDetailId};})()
